question: P, A, R, T, L and Y live on six different floors of the same building. The lowermost floor in the building is numbered 1, the floor above it, number 2 and so on till the topmost floor is numbered 6. No one lives below R. Only A lives above T. Only two people live between R and P. Y lives on an even numbered floor. R lives on the lowermost floor. How many people live between L and A?
solution:

2) Only A lives above T.
